column1: # id<TAB>sources (comma-separated, "-" = none)<TAB>shell command, run in /lab by run-capture.sh

column3: gcc --version | head -1; clang --version | head -1; gdb --version | head -1; valgrind --version; rr --version; ldd --version | head -1; uname -m; echo "ulimit -c: $(ulimit -c)"; echo "rr-smoke($(head -1 .rr-caps 2>/dev/null || echo none))"
make -s core-01-null ARGS=plain >/dev/null 2>&1 && gdb -q -batch -nx -x gdb/01-null-core.gdb ./01-null.plain cores/01-null.plain-plain.core
make -s core-01-null ARGS=field >/dev/null 2>&1 && gdb -q -batch -nx -x gdb/01-null-field.gdb ./01-null.plain cores/01-null.plain-field.core
make -s core-01-null ARGS=fnptr >/dev/null 2>&1 && gdb -q -batch -nx -x gdb/01-null-fnptr.gdb ./01-null.plain cores/01-null.plain-fnptr.core

make -s 07-leak.plain && mkdir -p cores && rm -f cores/07-leak.exit.core && gdb -q -batch -nx -ex 'break main' -ex run -ex 'break _exit' -ex continue -ex 'generate-core-file cores/07-leak.exit.core' ./07-leak.plain >/dev/null 2>&1 && gdb -q -batch -nx -x gdb/07-leak-core.gdb ./07-leak.plain cores/07-leak.exit.core

make -s 09-deadlock.plain && mkdir -p cores && rm -f cores/09.* && { ./09-deadlock.plain hang & pid=$!; sleep 2; gcore -o cores/09 $pid; kill $pid; } && gdb -q -batch -nx -x gdb/09-deadlock-core.gdb ./09-deadlock.plain cores/09.$pid

make -s 10-refcount-uaf.plain && for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do ./10-refcount-uaf.plain >/tmp/run$i 2>&1; echo "rc=$?" >>/tmp/run$i; echo "run $i: $(tail -1 /tmp/run$i)"; done 2>/dev/null; echo "--- run 1 output:"; cat /tmp/run1; echo "unique=$(for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do md5sum </tmp/run$i; done | sort -u | wc -l)"
make -s 10-refcount-uaf.plain && export _RR_TRACE_DIR=/tmp/rr && rm -rf /tmp/rr && rr record ./10-refcount-uaf.plain; echo "rr record: rc=$?"; rr replay -o -q < gdb/10-rr.gdb

make -s core-10-refcount-uaf V=stripped >/dev/null 2>&1 && mkdir -p cores/nodebug && cp 10-refcount-uaf.stripped cores/nodebug/ && gdb -q -batch -nx -iex 'set debug-file-directory /nonexistent' -x gdb/t2-stripped.gdb cores/nodebug/10-refcount-uaf.stripped cores/10-refcount-uaf.stripped.core

make -s 08-race.plain && for i in $(seq 200); do ./08-race.plain; done >/tmp/stress; echo "runs=$(wc -l </tmp/stress)"; grep -o 'actual=[0-9]*' /tmp/stress | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5; echo "distinct=$(grep -o 'actual=[0-9]*' /tmp/stress | sort -u | wc -l)"

make -s 08-race.plain && rm -rf /tmp/rr && mkdir -p /tmp/rr && hit=; for i in $(seq 50); do rr record --chaos -o /tmp/rr/t$i ./08-race.plain >/tmp/rec$i 2>&1; echo "try $i: $(grep -o 'actual=[0-9]* lost=[0-9]*' /tmp/rec$i)"; if grep -q 'lost=[1-9]' /tmp/rec$i; then hit=$i; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$hit" ]; then echo "lossy on try $hit of 50"; echo "--- lossy recording $hit:"; grep '^expected=' /tmp/rec$hit; echo "--- rr replay -a /tmp/rr/t$hit:"; rr replay -a /tmp/rr/t$hit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/rep; r=$(grep -o 'actual=[0-9]*' /tmp/rec$hit); p=$(grep -o 'actual=[0-9]*' /tmp/rep); if [ -n "$r" ] && [ "$r" = "$p" ]; then echo "replay matches lossy recording: $p"; else echo "replay MISMATCH: $r vs $p"; fi; else echo "no lossy recording in 50 tries"; fi
